name: Collection Tag Rules
description: Scheduled task that auto-tags items missing every marker tag in a rule with the rule's exclude tag, and removes it again once a marker tag is added, so you can filter the dashboard by what a group is not.
overview: Rule-based auto-tagging for filtering out a group's items

versions.changelog: Initial release: rule-based collection tagging (marker tags / exclude tag / item types), self-correcting scheduled task.
